revisions.concept: Close-up: one large expressive adult Iron Age digger, bearded, in a plain linen tunic, fills half the frame on one side, holding an iron pick and listening with intense focus. Behind him only a dark rough rock tunnel wall and one small clay oil lamp flame. Brighter saturated colours, simple top quarter, no machines, no clutter, no lettering.
revisions.reason: Run 38030855354 rejected thumbnail-C (historicalAccuracy, correctProp): a jointed pump-like mechanical contraption and cluttered tools and vessels behind the worker. The repair keeps the approved listening-digger subject with only the rock wall and one clay lamp behind him.
